name: cli-templates-show
body: `kalide templates <name>` shows the template's fields (type, required, default, limits, formats, description), its sections — for a slide template the child sections it declares, and for a section template the child sections it can hold — each with the section templates it accepts and its min/max repeats, its body rules, and its example slide. Unknown name = error with closest-match suggestion. A tree view of a template's nesting (its composed child sections, recursively) is a nice-to-have.
